scope: Local coarse-ROI scene, one continuous vessel, synthetic acoustic quality, offline static robot endpoint witnesses.
planner_geometry_input: Shared nominal clipping only. The public shape prior describes the simulator support; there is no runtime particle filter.

simulator.mechanism: Y = -0.20 + 0.09*tanh((clipped image length in m - .018)/.015) + b + theta*(yaw/.10) + eps
simulator.success: Realized terminal Y >= 0 and independent evaluation of the physical gate on the rendered true centerline.
simulator.arms: Persistent theta or an independent theta redraw at terminal only. b and geometry are unchanged.
simulator.paired_noise: Common Gaussian noise keyed by object and action, plus visit number for probes. The arms share probe outcomes and same-action terminal noise.

action_price.utility: Pr(physical and acoustic success) - .04 * elapsed seconds
action_price.termination: Exactly one terminal. Two terminal dwells exceed budget. Each probe endpoint can be revisited.

planner.learned: Fit random intercept and slope moments to grouped repeated public Y minus nominal geometry. Carry Gaussian precision and precision-weighted mean.
planner.fixed: Select one of two balanced probe orders by public expected utility before observations, then use same learned terminal selection; also compare the canonical minus then plus order.
planner.difference: Canonical minus then plus; subtract nominal geometry at each probe; intercept is mean, slope is difference divided by .50; choose highest nominal terminal plus extrapolated residual.
planner.reset_aware: Retain learned posterior on b. Marginalize a fresh independent theta using the learned prior marginal.
